Object subclass: #BoundedStack
	instanceVariableNames: 'collection capacity'
	classVariableNames: ''
	poolDictionaries: ''
	category: 'BoundedStack'

BoundedStack class defineMethod: 'errorCapacityMustBePositiveInteger
	^''capacity must be a positive integer'''

BoundedStack class compile: 'errorCapacityMustBePositiveInteger
	^''capacity must be a positive integer'''

BoundedStack class compile: 'errorStackIsFull
	^''stack is full'''

BoundedStack class compile: 'errorStackIsEmpty
	^''stack is empty'''

BoundedStack class compile: 'assertIsValidCapacity: aCapacity
	(aCapacity isInteger and: [aCapacity > 0]) ifFalse: [
		self error: self errorCapacityMustBePositiveInteger ]'

BoundedStack class compile: 'capacity: aCapacity
	self assertIsValidCapacity: aCapacity.
	^self new initializeCapacity: aCapacity'

BoundedStack compile: 'initializeCapacity: aCapacity
	capacity := aCapacity.
	collection := OrderedCollection new'

BoundedStack compile: 'push: anObject
	(collection size >= capacity) ifTrue: [
		self error: self class errorStackIsFull ].
	collection add: anObject'

BoundedStack compile: 'pop
	collection isEmpty ifTrue: [
		self error: self class errorStackIsEmpty ].
	^collection removeLast'

BoundedStack compile: 'top
	collection isEmpty ifTrue: [
		self error: self class errorStackIsEmpty ].
	^collection last'

BoundedStack compile: 'isEmpty
	^collection isEmpty'

BoundedStack compile: 'size
	^collection size'
